chapter: Forming the band in New York
title: Personnel of the original band
summary: Hawkins lists the trumpets, trombones, saxes and rhythm section of the early band and the later additions.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: How large was the band at this time?
Earl and the two trombones, that was Bob and Ed, three trumpets, four saxes, and four rhythm.
Would it be possible for you to name the fellows that were playing in the band? Is that feasible?

Trumpets - Dud Bascomb, Marcellus Green, and myself. Bob Range and Edward Sims were trombone. Tracy, I can't remember the first name, and Jimmy Mitchelle, Richard Sanford. That's one, two three. That's three of them on sax. I've got one other one. It'll come to me in a minute. Oh, that's right. (Unclear) When we got there, Haywood joined us. That made the fourth sax. And then, later Julian Dash came in and made the five. Then, after that, Sammy Lowe was sent back and he came in. And then later on, Tracy went out and Paul Bascomb came in. Then, Richard Harris, "Dick" Harris came in. That made my third trombone at that time. After Sammy Lowe, then I called his name. He came in for the trumpet section. Did I call
Oh, James Morrison Marshall was drums. Lee Stanfield was bass. Avery Parrish was piano, and William McLamore was guitar.
